items.title: Devin Vassell on Spurs' three-guard starting lineup:
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Devin Vassell on Spurs' three-guard starting lineup:

"You don't know who to pick up. It's Fox, it's Dylan, it's Steph. We have five ball handlers that can come down and attack the basket and make a play. I think it's going to be tough for other teams."

items.title: Devin Vassell after practice this morning on Tarris Reed Jr.'s rebounding:
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Devin Vassell after practice this morning on Tarris Reed Jr.'s rebounding:

"Oh, man, that's a monster right there...I call him a walking 10 boards. As soon as he gets in the game, I feel like he's getting 10 boards."
